blocks.text: The Lenovo 15.6" Laptop casual backpack B210 is the sleek and lightweight solution to all of your notebook computer carrying needs. With its casual, modern design and water-repellent fabric, this is a laptop case that's perfectly suited to your daily life. Adjustable, padded shoulder straps and a quilted back panel make it easy and comfortable to carry, while the padded laptop compartment keeps your computer or tablet safe inside. Plus, the quick-access front pocket gives you convenient access to your accessories. This appealing Lenovo Laptop backpack offers an integrated laptop compartment that comfortably fits most laptops up to 15.6", a range of internal pockets for those must-have accessories, and a spacious main compartment for books and other items. Its clean, sleek look is great for both men and women, business professionals and college students alike. There's plenty of room inside, so just grab and go! Dimensions: 17.93 x 13.4 x 5.91 inches. Fits up to (L x D x H) 10.0 x 0.8 x 14.2 inches.

items.label: Durable design
items.value: Laptop backpack features a durable, water-repellent snow yarn polyester fabric and streamlined design with a padded interior to protect your laptop, notebook and other important stuff

items.label: Comfortable fit
items.value: This compact backpack has a quilted back panel and fully adjustable shoulder straps making it comfortable for all day use, plus a quick access front zippered pocket for extra storage

items.label: Laptop backpack
items.value: Perfect for daily commuters, college students and all types of travelers; accommodates laptops up to 15.6 inches

items.label: Convenient storage
items.value: In addition to the laptop compartment, there are separate pockets for mobile devices, business cards, and other daily tools in quick-access compartments. The main compartment offers extra space for magazines, notepad and other laptop accessories

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Adjustable Shoulder Strap, Laptop Compartment, Lightweight, Magazine Holder, Water Resistant
